{"metadata":{"description":"在开发页面点击任意 UI 元素，一键定位 Vue / React / Svelte / Angular 源码。DSH 点击定位源码检查器，兼容 dsh-better-sidebar：预览本地 dev server，点击元素，源码直达 DSH 聊天，交给助手微调。Click a UI element in your dev page to jump to its Vue / React / Svelte / Angular source in the DSH chat. DeepSeek Harness click-to-source inspector,","id":"gh:1334737461","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"DSH-element-source","slug":"GULI-lab/DSH-element-source","topics":["click-to-source","code-inspection","code-inspector","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","inspect-element","react","source-location","vue"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"在开发页面点击任意 UI 元素，一键定位 Vue / React / Svelte / Angular 源码。DSH 点击定位源码检查器，兼容 dsh-better-sidebar：预览本地 dev "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"server，点击元素，源码直达 DSH 聊天，交给助手微调。Click a UI element in your dev page to jump to its Vue / React / Svel"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"te / Angular source in the DSH chat. DeepSeek Harness click-to-source inspector,"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-element-source"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Click-to-source for the DeepSeek Harness built-in browser.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Open your frontend dev page in DSH's built-in browser, turn on the picker from the
browser's own too"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"lbar, then click the **「添加到对话」** pill on the element you want.
The element's source file — with its "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"line — lands in the current session's chat
composer as a **file reference chip**, and clicking that "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"chip opens the built-in
preview scrolled to the exact line. Nothing is sent until you send it."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 0.2.0 — rebuilt around the built-in browser"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"This release is a deliberate reset of the plugin's product surface: **it is built
for the DeepSeek H"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"arness built-in browser and nothing else.**"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Built-in browser only.** The old "Local preview" tab, the right-docked
sidebar, the iframe previ"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ew and the preview proxy are gone. Use the browser
that ships with the DSH desktop app.
- **dsh-bett"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"er-sidebar is no longer supported.** Its integration, the "Local
preview" tab and the fallback sideb"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ar were removed. Installing both is not a
supported configuration; if you installed dsh-better-sideb"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ar only for this
plugin, you can remove it.
- **One icon in the browser's own toolbar.** On a develo"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"pment page the plugin
appends a select-element icon as the **last item of the browser toolbar** (to
"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"the right of the open-external button). The address bar shrinks to make room;
there is no plugin add"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ress bar, tab strip or sidebar. The button is removed
again as soon as the page stops being a develo"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"pment page.
- **Picker enabled by default, page protected.** While picking, ordinary page
clicks and"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" the context menu are neutralized (no navigation, no theme toggle,
no form submit) and only the pill"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" performs a pick — so a click intended as a
selection can never operate the page.
- **A pick becomes"},{"id":"p8s12","text":" a file reference chip.** The composer receives the located
file (and line) as a chip; click it to o"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"pen the built-in preview scrolled to
that line. The plugin never sends a message for you.
- **Instal"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"l into the desktop profile.** The built-in browser lives in the DSH
desktop app, so the one-command "},{"id":"p8s15","text":"installer defaults to profile `desktop`."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Why remove the old preview?** The built-in browser already provides the
address bar, tabs, history"},{"id":"p9s2","text":", cookies and the Electron session. A second
iframe/proxy duplicated that surface and competed with "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"dsh-better-sidebar for the
same slot. The plugin now does two things only: add the picker to the bro"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"wser
toolbar, and hand the located file to the current chat composer."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Requirement | Details |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| DSH | **DSH desktop app 0.2.x** with the built-in browser. The web-only `dsh web` page has no Elec"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"tron `<webview>`, so no picker appears there. |
| Frontend | A running dev server (Vite, webpack, et"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"c.) and a **development build** of your page. |
| Workspace | The current session's working director"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"y must be your frontend project root. The resolver refuses files outside it. |
| Framework | React, "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"Vue 2/3, Svelte, Angular, code-inspector, or the generic text-search fallback. |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Production builds carry no runtime source metadata, so the picker only appears
on development pages."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### What the composer receives"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- Primary path: a **file reference chip** such as `LoginPage.tsx:90`, using the
same `@path` mention"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" semantics as the built-in `@` file menu. The chip
serializes as the `@path:90` mention, so the agen"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"t receives the located line;
it is clickable and jumps to the line in the built-in preview.
- Fallba"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ck: if the composer reference API is unavailable, plain
`[元素定位] src/App.vue:12` text is appended to "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"the draft.
- Nothing is sent automatically. Set `autoSteer: true` only if you want the
session agent"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" to be woken with a bilingual located-source message immediately
after a pick."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"No page proxy and no second UI stack. The probe is injected directly into the
Electron `<webview>`, "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"so the page keeps its real origin and its own network
behavior. Resolution is bounded (2.5 s search "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"budget, 60 s result cache) so a
pick in a large monorepo does not stall the composer."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `POST /dsh-element-source/api/pick` is public and CORS-open because the page
runs in an isolated w"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ebview. It is write-only: a bounded FIFO queue (32 picks),
no pick data is returned.
- `GET /dsh-ele"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ment-source/api/pending` sits behind the same browser-trust fence
as the DSH `/api` gateway and requ"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ires a real session.
- Resolution uses the session's authoritative `cwd`; a resolved file outside th"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"e
workspace is refused. `mappings` can rebase a path but cannot escape the
workspace.
- `inject.js` "},{"id":"p20s6","text":"is public read-only probe code. It collects element metadata and
optional framework source metadata;"},{"id":"p20s7","text":" it does not touch DSH data.
- There is no preview proxy and no arbitrary URL fetching anymore, so t"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"he old
proxy-origin trade-off is gone."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Desktop app only.** The web-only `dsh web` UI has no Electron `<webview>`
pages, so the toolbar "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"icon and probe never appear there.
- **Development pages only.** Production builds have no runtime s"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ource metadata;
the icon is hidden and removed on such pages.
- **Toolbar DOM is internal.** The sel"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ect icon is appended to the built-in
browser's toolbar. A future DSH UI refactor may require a plugi"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"n update.
- **Workspace confinement.** If the session workspace is not the project root,
picks resol"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ve to the wrong tree or are refused. Switch the session workspace
first.
- **Vue lines are heuristic"},{"id":"p22s7","text":".** Icon-only or textless elements may degrade to
file-level or component-definition locations.
- **"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"Angular / Svelte need dev builds.** Production builds carry no usable source
metadata.
- **Auto-stee"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"r needs a live agent.** `autoSteer` only wakes an existing session
agent; it never sends a composer "},{"id":"p22s10","text":"draft for you.
- **dsh-better-sidebar is unsupported.** The old sidebar entry is gone; there is
no f"},{"id":"p22s11","text":" **dsh-better-sidebar is unsupported.** The old sidebar entry is gone; there is
no fallback sidebar."}],"truncated":true}
